after.tests/test_notices.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

STUDENT = Student("s1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")


def make_mark(ident, month, status):
    return Mark(ident, date(2026, month, 1), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            make_mark("s1", 3, "absent"),
            make_mark("s1", 2, "present"),
            make_mark("s1", 1, "absent")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks),
            "Ada Lovelace was absent on 2 day(s): "
            "2026-01-01, 2026-03-01."
        )

    def test_other_student_mark_raises(self):
        marks = [make_mark("s2", 1, "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_raises(self):
        marks = [make_mark("s1", 1, "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
